description: Review release readiness without claiming unrun checks passed
---
# Release review

Follow `AGENTS.md`, `docs/QUALITY-GATES.md`, `docs/SECURITY.md` and `templates/RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md`.

Review current diff/build. Identify correctness, concurrency, security, resource leaks, lifecycle, rollback, license, accessibility and performance risks. Run available checks, list exact outcomes, and mark missing platform/packaging tests **Not verified**. Provide severity, file/location, suggested fix, release blockers and residual risks.
